SelectionPolicy: Finite authored pairs only; never a Cartesian product or procedural prop factory. Select only qualified pairs after indexed-site integration. Reuse unchanged HCSceneKits.Find layouts and native observer/materializer cleanup.
IdentityPolicy: Candidate and site IDs are reusable template keys, never story identities. HC-19 alone issues monotonically unique identities and commits the selected kit/site plan before materialization. Preserve pinned legacy plans, completion watermarks and terminal exceptions; no replay, refill or history reset.
SchedulePolicy: Reuse HC-19 ArrivalSeconds, Window and world-UTC schedule, including one eligible arrival after downtime and no catch-up burst. HCVisualSeasons is not this clock. Scene activation remains capped at two leases.
QualificationPolicy: SourceReviewed is data provenance only. A zero-height HC-43 label is not a ground transform. Qualified requires an exact kit/site/layout native survey receipt plus DayZDiag, signed PBO/server and two-client acceptance; no JSON flag alone admits placement.
CluePolicy: Setting is authored design text, not a published world fact or observed outcome. Radio reports, notes and body clues use their existing owners; no quest, dialogue or trader interface. Fold Morse into ordinary radio reports. Static bags are scenery, never corpses or inventory.
InventoryPolicy: All ten kits remain empty non-inventory scenery. No item creation, cargo replenishment, fuel grant, corpse mutation, new inventory owner or CE lifecycle adoption.
RangePolicy: No new ranges or offsets; unchanged kit transforms and existing placement/observer constraints apply. Locality map labels grant no radius-based coverage or access.

Coverage.Eligibility: Every locality and island remains eligible over time; pending geometry/access and temporary quiet never exclude a locality.
Coverage.PendingResidentialReason: All 64 memberships source-resolved; native layout and access acceptance pending.
